title.full: How much CPF LIFE can pay

summary.text: Your payout depends on your RA savings and starting age. It can be up to $3,440 monthly from 65, or $4,580 from 70.

details.heading: Starting at age 65
details.body: You can receive up to $3,440 per month for life. The amount depends on your Retirement Account savings.

details.heading: Starting at age 70
details.body: For each year you defer your payouts, they can increase by up to 7%. Starting at age 70, you can receive up to $4,580 per month.

sources.page_title: How much CPF payouts can I get every month?

quotes.text: Your monthly payout amount depends on the amount of savings in your Retirement Account (RA) and your age at the point you start your payouts. Under CPF LIFE, you can receive up to $3,440 per month for life starting from age 65.
Under CPF LIFE, you can receive up to $3,440 per month for life starting from age 65.
For each year that you defer, your payouts will increase by up to 7%. This means that you can receive up to $4,580 if you choose to start your payout at age 70.
